Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show the Ski Resort button (top left)
Shows a Ski Resort button at the top left of the screen. The button opens the hub: your runs, the resort totals and every building tool in one place. The hub is also always in the Universal Mod Panel.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Open the hub when a Welcome Sign is selected
Selecting a Ski Area Welcome Sign opens the Ski Resort hub beside its panel. It never closes the hub. The hub closes with its X or Escape.
How often residents spend a day out skiing. More attraction, fresh snow and a shorter trip bring more. A lift ticket price above 40 brings fewer. 0 turns ski days off for residents. Default 25 %.
How often hotel guests spend a day out skiing, moved by the same things. 0 turns ski days off for tourists. Default 50 %.
Nobody farther than this from a lodge, in a straight line, is sent skiing there. Fewer come the farther they live. Default 7 km (4.3 mi).
How much a fresh-snow day adds. At 100 % a full powder day doubles the residents who go. At 0, powder brings no extra skiers. Default 100 %.

How far a ski area reaches from its Welcome Sign. Lifts, lodges, ski schools and patrol huts belong to the nearest sign within this distance. They update when this value changes, also while the game runs. A run links to the nearest sign within it when you draw it and keeps that sign. Default 5 km (3.1 mi).

How much a ski area's runs and lifts add to its attraction score. Score = (lodge base + K × the square root of (runs and running lifts × variety × vertical)) × the Welcome Sign's efficiency. The score is at most 200. Default 4. In winter, with every run open at full efficiency, a small ski area scores about 50. A medium one scores about 95, a large one about 160.
What a run that no running lift serves is worth, as a percentage of a lift-served run. A run is lift-served when a complete, powered lift reaches its top. Default 40 %.

What each guest pays on arrival, one price for every ski area. Resort income shows in the Economy panel under public transportation fees: the game has no ski line. Above 40 it lowers ski days: about 90 % as many at 60, 80 % at 80, 20 % at 200. Visitors the game sends on its own come at any price and still pay it. 0 turns lift tickets off. Default 80.

What each paying ski guest also spends at the lodge they arrive at. Bigger lodges get more: at the default, 15 at a hut or A-frame, 23 at a chalet and 45 at a summit or grand lodge. It comes out of what the household has left after the lift ticket, so nothing is spent while lift tickets are off. 0 turns it off. Default 15.

At a ski area with a working ski school, this share of the people who go skiing that day also take a lesson. The household pays from what it has left after the lift ticket or pass. 0 turns lessons off. Default 30 %.
A lesson costs this many lift tickets at the day's ticket price. Needs a lift ticket price above 0. Default 1.5.

On: after half a day with no open run in a ski area, its lodges and ski school keep half their staff. They also pay half the wages. This lasts until a run opens again. Upkeep stays. A deactivated lodge costs a tenth of its upkeep and no wages. Default on.

The share of resident households that buy a season pass (the season starts 5 months before the map's winter). Each household within the longest ski-day trip rolls once when a ski area opens for a new season. Its chance is this share times its chance of skiing there. Households that moved in later, or live farther away, roll on their first visit. Holders ski free at the gate and go skiing more often. Tourists never buy one. 0 turns passes off. Default 50 %.

A season pass costs this many lift tickets at the ticket price when it is sold, locked for the season. It saves money for a household that skis more often than this many times. Needs a lift ticket price above 0. Default 2.

On: a run adds to its ski area's score only while snow lies on it. A run opens when 60 % of it has 91 cm (3 ft) of snow and closes below 40 %. The snow is measured in the game's own snow, or estimated from the climate until the first measurement. A ski area with no open run counts as summer sightseeing. Off: every run counts as open all year, for maps without winter. Runs pay upkeep only while their grooming or snow guns run, so on a warm map with gating off they cost no upkeep. Default on.

Snow guns on snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks work where the air on the run is at most this many degrees above freezing. They work from 2 months before winter to 1 month after, until the run has 91 cm (3 ft) of snow. Higher means a longer season and a bigger snowmaking bill. Default 3.3 °C (6 °F): guns run in air up to 3.3 °C (38 °F).
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Link runs the moment they are drawn
When enabled, a run drawn within the ski area radius of a Welcome Sign links to that ski area at once. It pays its fee at that moment, also while the game is paused. Waiting runs link the moment a sign is placed. Disabled: runs link at the next periodic check, which happens only while the game is running. Default on.

When enabled, drawing or editing a ski run shows a slope heat-map over the run: gray flat, green, blue, black, red double black. A tooltip shows its rating, hardest unavoidable pitch, length and vertical drop. Default on.
When enabled, terrain contour lines turn on while a ski run is selected in the area tool and turn off again afterward. If you already had them on, they stay on. Default on.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show the winter snow line while placing
When enabled, drawing a ski run or placing a Ski Area Welcome Sign draws two lines on the terrain. One is the average winter snow line, where the December-February average climate reaches freezing, even in summer. A fainter one below it shows where snow guns start to work. The tooltip gives both heights and the height under the cursor. While you place a sign, it also gives the lowest and highest dry ground within the ski area radius. It adds the vertical above the snow line and how much ground lies above it. Default on.

When enabled, a ring on the ground shows how far a ski area reaches (the ski area radius). It appears around the cursor while placing a Welcome Sign, around a selected sign, and around every sign while placing a run or lift. It also appears around every sign while placing a resort building. A blue ring shows the lodge parking radius. Car spaces inside it count for the lodge. It appears around the cursor while placing an A-frame, Chalet or Grand lodge, and around a selected one. Default on.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Show run names on the hill
When enabled, each ski run's name appears on the ground at the run's center, in its difficulty color. This happens while the camera is at piste-map distance. Handy in summer, when the runs carry no snow. The names step aside while you draw or edit a run. Default on.
How thick the outline and corner dots are while you draw, edit or bulldoze a ski run. Each step adds 0.3 m (1 ft). 0 keeps the game's thin outline. Default 8: 2.4 m (8 ft).

Snow guns on snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks show a vapor plume while they run. They run when it is cold enough at the gun and the run's snow is below the depth where the guns stop. Look only: snow and upkeep do not change. Default on.
One snow groomer drives each linked cat track while the track is open. Look only: snow, rating and upkeep do not change. Default on.
The steepest a cat track may climb. A track that cannot stay under it turns red and asks for more length (a switchback). Default 25 %.
Width of the cat track: the flat top the tool cuts and fills, and the run built on it. Default 20 m (66 ft).
How far the cut bank extends for each meter (foot) it drops, where the track cuts into the hill. Lower is steeper. Default 1.5: 1.5 m out per 1 m down.
How far the fill bank extends for each meter (foot) it rises, where the track is built up. Lower is steeper. Default 2: 2 m out per 1 m up.
Off: the track follows the ground and moves as little earth as the max grade allows. On: one even slope from end to end. Default off.

Outline a mountainside and the planner proposes lifts and a set of linked runs around them. You review and change the plan, place the lift stations yourself, and build the runs together, with an optional tree filler. Experimental. Off: the tool cannot open and its hub button is grayed. Default off.
Shows a guide line and an offset readout while you place a station. The bulldozer warns what a click on a lift removes. Default on.

After you draw or change a lift line, the mod raises its towers and moves them along the line. Chairs and cabins then stay at least 3 m (10 ft) above the ground (trams 5 m, 16 ft). Off: the towers stay where the game puts them. Default on.
Grips follow the slope of the rope, and chairs and cabins swing in the wind. Off: they hang level and still. Default on.

For field tests, off by default. Turns on extra measurements that cost a little frame time (a daily ski-day measurement pass and the Ctrl+Alt+G slope capture file). Leave it off for normal play. Default off.
Options.OPTION[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMod: Resort Planner on the main thread
For field tests, off by default. The Resort Planner scans on a background thread. Turn this on to scan on the game's main thread in small steps instead (slower, same result). Use it only if a scan never finishes or the log reports a scan worker error. A worker error turns the Resort Planner off until the next game load. Default off.

Copies a short report for a bug report to the clipboard. It has the mod and game versions, your computer, the options you changed and the code mods loaded. It also has where the mod log is and its latest error lines. Paste it into your report. Your Windows user name is left out.
Puts every Modular Ski Resort option and key binding back to its default. It asks you first.
Options.WARNING[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMo: Reset all Modular Ski Resort options and key bindings to their defaults?
Deletes everything Modular Ski Resort placed in this city. That is lifts and their towers, stations, lodges, the ski school, patrol huts, Welcome Signs, ski runs, cat tracks and safety fences. It also deletes the trees the tree tool or the Resort Planner planted. Use it before you unsubscribe. Your own power lines, roads and buildings are not touched. Terrain graded for cat tracks stays as it is. Snow already on the runs melts with the weather. Felled trees do not come back. If one of your power lines ends at a base station, bulldoze that last span first. This cannot be undone: save your city first. Available only in a loaded city.
Options.WARNING[SkiResortMod.SkiResortMo: Delete every lift, station, lodge, run, cat track and fence of Modular Ski Resort in this city? This cannot be undone.
Opens or closes the tree tool. Point at a run of a ski area to preview it at the chosen tree density (felled, removed and planted trees). Left click applies. Works in a loaded city only. Default Ctrl+Shift+G.

Opens or closes the lift-line tool. Click a lift station, then the other station of the same lift. The planned towers appear (fewest towers, tall ones where they save a tower). Click on the line to add a tower. Drag a tower to move it, or release it off the line to remove it. Right click or Esc steps back. Then press the Build key. Default Ctrl+Shift+L.
Builds the line the lift-line tool shows, with exactly the towers on screen. Only while the tool is open. In the cat track tool it grades and builds the track shown. Default Enter.

Opens or closes the cat track tool (the hub's Cat track tile). In the tool, click points up the mountain and drag a point to move it. Right click steps back. Enter grades the ground and builds the track. Default Ctrl+Shift+K.

Turns the cat track tool's delete mode on or off. In delete mode, click a cat track to select it and click it again to delete it (the ground stays graded, no refund). Right click or Esc leaves delete mode. Only while the tool is open. The hub Runs tab's Delete cat tracks chip does the same. Default Ctrl+Shift+D.

Opens or closes the Resort Planner (also a button on the hub's Runs tab). In the planner, click the corners of a region, then press Enter to scan it. Click a run to exclude it, then press Enter to build. Inert while the Resort Planner is off. Default Ctrl+Shift+Q.

Steps the tree density the tree tool brings a run to. 1 clears the run, each higher level holds more trees per hectare (felling or planting to reach it), and 8 is a thick forest. After 8 it starts again at 1. Only while the tree tool is open. Default Shift+G.
Switches what the tree tool works on: the trees inside the run, or the tree line along its outside edge. Only while the tree tool is open. Default Alt+G.
Writes the drawing-feedback and tree-tool state to the mod log, also while a run is on the cursor. Needs Measurement diagnostics on. Default Ctrl+Alt+G.

Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSignSetPatrolHut]: The Ski Patrol Hut's lettered boards. The building places them. Placed alone, they float.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSignSetPatrolHQ]: The Ski Patrol HQ's lettered board. The building places it. Placed alone, it floats.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSignSetGate]: The Welcome Sign's lettered header. The sign places it. Placed alone, it floats.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSignSetGrand]: The Grand Lodge name board. The building places it. Placed alone, it floats.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSafetyFence]: Orange plastic safety netting on thin poles. Purely decorative.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiNetPost]: The safety net fence's end post. The fence places it by itself.
Assets.NAME[SkiSafetyFenceLane]: Safety Net Fence Lane (part of the fence)
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSafetyFenceLane]: The netting the safety net fence draws between its posts.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunTowerLow]: A fan gun on a short mast. It blows water and air through a nozzle ring into a mist. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunTower]: A fan gun on a mast. It blows water and air through a nozzle ring into a mist. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunTowerTall]: A fan gun on a tall mast. It blows water and air through a nozzle ring into a mist. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunFan]: A fan gun on wheels, aimed up. It blows water and air through a nozzle ring into a mist. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunFanIdle]: A fan gun on wheels, parked with its barrel down. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunLance]: A snow lance: a tall inclined aluminum tube with the nucleator at the head. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunLanceTall]: A tall snow lance: an inclined aluminum tube with the nucleator at the head. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiSnowGunLanceDown]: A snow lance folded down. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place it by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiHydrantBox]: The water and air hookup for snow lances and fan guns, with a coiled hose. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place these by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiHydrantBoxBare]: The water and air hookup for snow lances and fan guns. Snowmaking runs, night runs and cat tracks place these by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiPisteFloodlightLow: A floodlight mast for night skiing. Night runs and lit cat tracks place floodlights by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiPisteFloodlight]: A floodlight mast for night skiing. Night runs and lit cat tracks place floodlights by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiPisteFloodlightTal: A tall floodlight mast for night skiing. Night runs and lit cat tracks place floodlights by themselves.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunSnowmakingBorde: Picks a random snow lance, fan gun, hydrant box or gap along a snowmaking run's edge.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunNightBorder]: Picks a random floodlight, snow lance, fan gun, hydrant box or gap along a night run's edge.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiPropNone]: Places nothing: run edges use it to leave gaps between their props.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunGroomedA]: A freeform ski run. Paint the trail. The grooming shows on the mountain and adds to the ski area's attraction.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunSnowmakingA]: A groomed run with snow guns: it holds its season longer and still scores in marginal weather.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunNightA]: A snowmaking run with floodlighting for a second, after-dark shift: the most expensive trail to keep open, and the biggest draw.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunNaturalA]: A marked trail on natural snow. Nothing is groomed or painted: the mountain's own snow is the run, and it opens only when real snow covers it. No upkeep. Cut the trail through the forest with the tree tool.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[SkiRunCatTrackA]: A groomed track up the hill, graded as you draw it. Always green. Counts a quarter of a run. Crosses other runs.

SkiResort.Tooltip.SLOPE_AVG_MAX_GENTLE: Avg {AD} ({AP}) · steepest {SD} ({SP}) · gentle run, short steep pitch

SkiResort.GladeTooltip.NO_RUNS: No ski run in this city is linked to a Welcome Sign yet
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.UNBOUND: Run not linked: no Ski Area Welcome Sign was within the ski area radius of its center

SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE: Nothing to change: the run is already at this tree density
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE_BLOCKED: Nothing more can be planted: the remaining spots are blocked (roads, buildings)
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.COMPLETE_FIXED: Nothing to change: the remaining trees cannot be felled (other runs', buildings')
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.CLAMPED: Large run: apply again to continue
SkiResort.GladeTooltip.MONEY: Some trees canceled: not enough money?

SkiResort.Hub.TITLE: Ski Resort
SkiResort.Hub.NOT_CONNECTED: The mod is not answering: its hub system is missing or failed. See SkiResortMod.Mod.log.
SkiResort.Hub.STAMP_DIFFERS: The UI bundle comes from a different build than the DLL.
SkiResort.Hub.UI_ERROR: The Ski Resort hub hit an error and was closed. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[NoSign]: Place a Ski Area Welcome Sign first
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[Missing]: Asset not found: is the Modular Ski Resort asset pack installed?
SkiResort.Hub.REASON[AlreadyBuilt]: Already built at this ski area
SkiResort.Hub.HINT[LiftNoPair]: A lift line needs both stations: a base and a top station.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[Disabled]: The tree tool hit an error and is off until the next load. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NotInGame]: The tree tool works in a loaded city only.
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NoRuns]: The ski run assets were not found: is the asset pack installed?
SkiResort.Hub.GLADE_REASON[NoSpecies]: No tree species to plant were found.
SkiResort.Hub.SECTION_FAILED: This part of the hub failed. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_EMPTY: No building tools were reported. See SkiResortMod.Mod.log.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_LODGE: Ski-day guests only use lodges within 800 m of runs or stations.
SkiResort.Hub.TREES_UNAVAILABLE: The tree tool is not available right now.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_LENGTH_TIP: Horizontal length, estimated from the outline.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_DROP_TIP: Approximate height from the lowest to the highest point of the outline.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOOL_TIP: Plan a lift line between two stations: Ctrl+Shift+L
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE: Available once a city is loaded.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TOOL_TIP: Outline a region and get a set of runs to pick from. Experimental. Ctrl+Shift+Q also opens it.
SkiResort.Hub.CAT_TRACK_DELETE_TIP: Opens the cat track tool in delete mode. The ground stays graded, no refund. Ctrl+Shift+D in the tool.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[Off]: Resort Planner is experimental and off. Its switch is in Options > Modular Ski Resort > Runs.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[NotArmed]: Available once a city is loaded.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REASON[Disabled]: The Resort Planner hit an error and is off until the next load. Details are in the mod log.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_UNAVAILABLE: The Resort Planner is not available right now.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_SCAN_TIP: Scan the outlined region for runs. Enter does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BUILD_TIP: Build every run that is not grayed out. Refused when the city cannot pay. A large region can take a few seconds to a minute.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_UNDO_TIP: Remove the runs of the last build and refund what they cost. Only this button does it: right click never removes built runs.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_KIND_TIP[Natural]: Black and harder runs stay ungroomed: no grooming fee or upkeep. Every other run is groomed.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_KIND_TIP[Snowmaking]: Green runs that reach the base get snow guns.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_KIND_TIP[Night]: Up to two base runs, blue or easier with the lowest tops, get snow guns and lights.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_START: Click the corners of a region on the map, then the first corner again.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REGION_LINE: {N} corners · {AREA} of {MAX} · vertical between the corners {V}
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_REGION_OVER: The region is larger than the limit shown above.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_PREVIEW_HINT: Click a run on the map to leave it out or take it back.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BUILDING: Building the runs. A large region can take a few seconds to a minute.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_STOP_TIP: Stop after the part in progress. What is built or planted so far stays, and Undo removes it. Right click does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_BATCH_LINE: Last build: {N} runs. Undo removes them and refunds the fee.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREES_TIP: Fill the outlined region with trees up to the tree line, around the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_PLANT_TIP: Plants a few thousand at a time, and removes trees a lower density or tree line no longer wants. Enter does the same.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREES_UNDO_TIP: Remove the trees of the last planting. Right click never removes planted trees.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_TREE_LINE_TIP: Trees grow up to this height. The default is where the wild trees nearby stop.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_SPECIES_TIP: One step before the first species: the whole group.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Start]: Click the first corner of the region you want runs on.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Corners]: Keep clicking corners. Three or more make a region.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Close]: Click the first corner to close the region and scan it. Enter does the same.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Ready]: Press Enter to scan the region. Drag a corner to reshape it. Right click reopens it.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Over]: Too big to scan. Drag a corner inward.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Drag]: Drag the corner and release it to place it.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Preview]: Click a run to leave it out or take it back. Enter builds. Right click leaves the preview.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Building]: Building the runs. A large region can take a few seconds to a minute. Right click stops the build. What is built stays.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Planting]: Planting the trees. A large region can take a few seconds to a minute. Right click stops the planting. What is planted stays.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Built]: Built. Undo in the Ski Resort hub removes this build and refunds its fee. Right click does not.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROMPT[Trees]: Tree filler: pick the tree line and species in the hub. Enter plants.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_MIX: Green {G} of {TG} · Blue {B} of {TB} · Black {K} of {TK} · Double black {D} of {TD}
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Gentle]: Gentle slope on average ({N} %): good for green and blue runs where it stays gentle.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Steep]: Steep slope (average {N} %): mostly blue and black runs. Greens need the gentlest parts.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[VerySteep]: Very steep (average {N} %): mostly black runs, few or no greens. Gentler ground lower down suits beginners.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE[Beyond]: Steeper than any real ski area (average {N} %): expect black and double black runs only. Look for gentler ground lower down for beginners.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[BadInput]: The region could not be read. Draw it again.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooLarge]: The region is over the size limit shown beside it, or its corners spread wider than about 5 km by 5 km.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooSmall]: The region is too small for a run.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooNarrow: The region is too narrow: a run needs open slope about 70 m across, clear of other areas.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[Blocked]: Most of the region is taken by other areas or by land the city does not own.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[NoVertica: The region has too little vertical for ski runs.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[OutsideTi: Part of this region is outside the city's map tiles, and no runs can go there.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[AllCliff]: The region is mostly cliff: no run can reach the bottom. Try a gentler slope.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[TooFlat]: The region is too flat for ski runs.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STATUS[NoRuns]: No run fits this region. Try another shape or another mix.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoGreen]: No green runs: the slope is too steep for them, or the gentle part at the bottom is too short.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoBlue]: No blue runs: the slope gives none.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoBlack]: No black runs fit this slope.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoEasyWayHo: A lift top here has no green way down.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoFlatRunou: No gentle runout at the bottom of the slope.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[MixShort]: Fewer runs of some colors than the mix asks for.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[CrossesCatT: A run crosses a cat track.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[PartlyBlock: Part of the region is blocked by other areas or by land the city does not own.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[MoneyShort]: The city cannot pay the total fee: building is refused.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[Renumber]: Runs with default names will be renumbered.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[OtherResort: These runs belong to more than one ski area.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoSign]: No Welcome Sign in range: the runs will not count until one is placed nearby.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[ChecksOff]: Anarchy is installed: while it is on, the game's own checks are off and only this tool's checks protect the build.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NEED_CORNERS: Click at least three corners first.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_RESCANNED: The map changed since the scan: scanned again. Check the preview and build again.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NOTHING_ENABLED: Every run is left out: click a run to take it back.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_DROPPED: The game refused some runs: they are red and left out. Building the rest.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_REFUSED: Nothing was built: the game refused the red runs. Build again to try the rest.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_STOPPED: Build stopped. The runs built so far stay. Undo removes them.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PARTIAL: Only some of the runs were built: the game refused the rest. Undo removes what was built.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_UNDONE: The build was undone and its fee refunded.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_RUNS_MISSING: The ski run assets did not load: check that the mod is installed completely.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_OFF: Turn the tree filler on first.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_COMPLETE: Nothing to plant: the region already has this many trees.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_BLOCKED: The game refuses some of these trees: planting stopped. Trees planted before stay.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_TREES_STOPPED: Planting stopped. The trees planted so far stay. Undo trees removes them.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_NO_SPECIES: No tree species of this kind were found.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_LIFTS_TIP: Auto picks the lift count from the size and height of the region.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_HOME_AUTO: Way home: green at the base, blue above
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_HOME_TIP: The easiest run down that each lift top should offer.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_POD_TIP: Click to leave this pod's runs out or take them back.
SkiResort.Hub.QUICK_LIFT_TIP: Click to leave this lift and the runs of its pod out or take them back.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_VERDICT[Download: No way down on skis: ride the lift down
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PLAN_LINE: Planned: {PODS} pod(s), {LIFTS} lift(s) proposed, {KM} km of runs
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_MIX_HONEST: The mountain gives green {G} %, blue {B} %, black {K} %
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_PROPOSAL_NOTE: Lifts are proposals: place the stations on the marked spots, then draw the line
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_AROUND_LIFT: Click a lift station to plan runs around it
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_SITE_DETAIL: Pods with their way home: {G} of {PODS}. Largest bench: {HA} ha
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[NoLiftSite]: No lift fits this region: the ground is too steep or too rough for a lift line, or has no flat spot for a station.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[Download]: Some lift tops have no way down on skis, so guests ride the lift down.
SkiResort.Tooltip.QUICK_WARN[DeadEnd]: A run ends where nothing continues: no lift, run, track or flat ground at its bottom.
SkiResort.Hub.RESORT_MENU_NOTE: Selecting a sign, a lodge or a station on the map shows its ski area here.
SkiResort.Hub.BUS_CARD[Distance]: To the hill lodge, straight line
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_CARD[Tip]: Merge fee: the tier's price less the building's own cost. Monthly fee: the tier's upkeep less its own, billed only near the runs and lifts.
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_CARD[Note]: Becomes one of this ski area's lodges and keeps working as before. Its tier adds score, skier room, staff and tourism. Guests still arrive through the road lodges.
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_CARD[Far]: Too far from the runs and lifts to count
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_CARD[UnmergeTip]: The building stays. Fees paid are not refunded.
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_CARD[TooSmall]: The lot is too small for any lodge tier
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_STATE[TooFar]: Too far from the runs and lifts
SkiResort.Hub.MERGED_FOLD_TIP: Buildings merged into this ski area as lodges. Each keeps working as before and adds its tier's score, skier room and staff.
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_TILE[Fact]: A landmark, signature or recreation building near the runs can serve as a lodge
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_TILE[Armed]: Outlined buildings can join this ski area as lodges
SkiResort.Hub.MERGE_WARN[NoGeometry]: No runs or lifts yet. Merges need one within {M} m.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_ENTRY: Not linked to a ski area
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_HINT: Out of range of every Welcome Sign.
SkiResort.Hub.RENAME_TIP: An empty name restores the default.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_DELETE_TIP: The ground stays graded and the fee is not refunded.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_DELETE_CONFIRM: Click again to delete this cat track.
SkiResort.Hub.UNRATEABLE: Cannot be rated: outline too large or too thin, or no terrain under it
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TOURISTS_TIP: An estimate from the game's tourist formula. Tourism mods can replace the formula, so real arrivals can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_TOWER_REMOVED: A tower was removed by another tool.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_NAME_TIP: The name is stored on the base station, or on the top station while there is no base.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_SIGN_TIP: A lift is linked to the ski area of its base station. A run stays linked to the ski area it was drawn for.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_HINT_SIGN: Starts a ski area: lifts and runs within its radius join it.
SkiResort.Hub.CONTRACT_MISMATCH_CORE: This panel (version {UI}) and the mod's DLL (version {DLL}) come from different builds. Building still works. The resort statistics stay hidden until the mod is reinstalled.
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[2]: A lift: two stations, then the line
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[3]: Runs from the top of the lift
SkiResort.Hub.START_STEP[4]: A lodge within 800 m of the runs
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_RULE: <mark:open> Open: enough snow on 60 % of the run. <mark:closed> Closed: under 40 %. <mark:patchy> Patchy: in between, and the run scores part of its value.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_ESTIMATED: Some runs are estimated from the day's temperature until their snow can be measured.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_GATING: Snow & season gating is off in Options, so every run counts as open.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_VISUALS: Snow is hidden in your Gameplay settings. Runs still open on the simulated snow.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[Unlinked]: Out of range of every Welcome Sign
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[LodgeNotSlopeside]: Lodge is far from the runs
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoLodge]: Ski days need any lodge within 800 m of the runs or lift stations. With no lodge, attraction is 0.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgesSomeOff]: Deactivated lodges do not count in the lodge base.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[Efficiency]: The Welcome Sign and its lodges, as in their info panels. Every cause that costs 5 % or more is listed below.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftNoPower]: Its base station has no power: the lift stops and serves no run. Upkeep is still charged.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftSectionMis: A section was removed or is being redrawn. Until the line is complete, the lift adds no points and pays a quarter of its upkeep.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftUnfinished: The line does not join a base station and a top station yet.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[Stations]: A station is placed, but no line joins it to its partner yet.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftChairsStop: The lift is complete and still adds its points, but its chairs stopped. The mod log says why.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsUnrateable: The outline is too large or too thin, or has no terrain under it. These runs add only a few points each.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsRating]: The mod rates runs one at a time. A new run adds 0 until it has a rating. A reshaped run keeps its last rating.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[FreeLodges]: They are out of range of every Welcome Sign, so they add nothing to any ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SchoolsNotLink: Out of range of every Welcome Sign, so they teach nobody.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SkiDaysCannotR: Many recent ski-day guests with a car did not reach the lodge in time. Fewer are sent until more arrive.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[DepotNoHillLod: A depot sends guests only while its ski area has a working hill lodge. A Hut or Summit counts. It bills nothing until then.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[DepotNoRoad]: A depot with no road sends nobody and bills nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SignNoRoad]: No active lodge with a road. The sign is the job host for the Hut, Summit, patrol and off-road lodges. Their staff come by road.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SkiDaysNoGuest: Ski-day guests come from homes and hotels, within the longest ski-day trip in Options. Beyond about 7 km few arrive in time.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoParkingNearL: No car spaces within 600 m. Tourists from outside the city drive here, so none arrive. Hotel guests within 900 m walk.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LodgeNotSlopes: Ski-day guests only go to a lodge within 800 m of this ski area's runs or lift stations.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[MixedLiftTypes: A line and its stations must be one lift type. Until then, the lift adds no points.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftTrainLimit: Wheels tilt 30° beyond the tower's lean (detachables, gondolas 40°, tram saddles 60°) and fold 40° (trams 60°). Past that the rope leaves them.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftBend]: Real lift lines turn 5° or less at a tower. Past that the rope runs off the outer wheels. The lift still runs and scores.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SummitLodgeNot: With every run closed, a Hut or Summit lodge scores more near a working lift top (300 m) or a served run (100 m).
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[SchoolNoGreenR: The ski school adds to the score only while at least one <icon:green> run is <icon:openpatchy>.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Attraction]: How strongly this ski area draws tourists, on the game's scale: a park is about 10, a landmark about 120. The most is 200.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_HELD: Checking runs and snow after loading. The game keeps the saved score meanwhile.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Runs]: Runs fully open now, out of all runs in this ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Lifts]: Complete lifts out of every lift drawn, unfinished ones included. Without power a complete lift stops and adds nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Guests]: {MONTH}: tourists who arrived at the lodges or the Welcome Sign, and residents who visited a lodge.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_SINCE_LOAD: Counted since you loaded the city.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[Money]: Net of the month so far: all resort income booked, minus lifts, runs, buildings and wages. The Finances view's Net.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_EST: ≈ Some income or costs are not counted yet. They show as 0.
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP_EST_BUILDINGS: ≈ The game's bill for buildings and wages is not known yet.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[LodgeBase]: The best lodge's value, plus a little for each other lodge, up to 24 more. About half while every run is closed.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Runs]: The total of all runs. Harder and bigger runs score more, and a run needs snow and a lift to score in full.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Lifts]: Points per complete, powered lift: fixed-grip 6, detachable 15, gondola 25, tram 30. While every run is closed, chairlifts and gondolas add a quarter.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[School]: An active ski school adds 12 while at least one <icon:green> run is <icon:openpatchy>.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Variety]: +15 % (1.15) while at least one <icon:green>, one <icon:blue> and one <icon:black> or <icon:dblack> run is <icon:openpatchy>. Otherwise no bonus.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Efficiency]: How well the Welcome Sign and its lodges work: staff, power, water, garbage, budget. The score uses a one-day average, held between 25 % and 100 %.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Result]: Lodge base plus runs, lifts and school, times efficiency, up to 200. A lodge's own info panel shows 0: it does not show this score.
SkiResort.Hub.SHARE_TIP: This ski area's part of what draws tourists to your city. The game squares each score, so 100 draws four times as much as 50.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Vertical]: From the lowest run bottom to the highest run top, closed runs too. ≈: some runs are still being rated.
SkiResort.Hub.AREA_TIP: The area of all runs, measured flat on the map, not along the slope.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Depth]: Average snow depth on the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.MOUNTAIN_TIP[Snow]: Share of the run area with enough snow to ski.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_NOTE: These runs and lifts belong to no ski area, so they score nothing and draw no guests.
SkiResort.Hub.TREE_TOOL_TIP: Plans trees on and around runs.
SkiResort.Hub.PISTE_MAP_TIP: Draws this ski area's runs on the ground in difficulty colors while the hub is open. Natural: dashed. Too flat: gray. Cannot be rated: orange.
SkiResort.Hub.COL_LIFT_TIP: ↑: a running lift reaches the top of this run.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[DepthReached]: Snow guns: off, the snow is deep enough
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[OutOfSeason]: Snow guns: off, out of season (2 months before winter to 1 month after)
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_GUNS[Waiting]: Snow guns: waiting for the first snow reading
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_OPEN_GATING: Counts as open: snow gating is off.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_SERVED_ANON: A running lift reaches its top.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_TYPE_NOTE: Natural green and blue runs count less. A groomed run counts in full.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_CAT_TRACK_NOTE: A cat track always rates green and counts a quarter of a run its size, in the score and the skier room.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_GUNS_TIP: Distance between snow guns on this run's edge. Off: no guns, no made snow and no snowmaking upkeep.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_GUNS_TIP[CatTrac: Distance between snow guns and hydrants on this cat track's edge. Off: no guns and no snowmaking upkeep. Made snow stays until it melts.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_LIGHTS_TIP: Distance between floodlight masts on this run's edge. Lit runs stay open in the evening. Off: no lights and no lighting upkeep.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_LIGHTS_TIP[CatTr: Distance between floodlight masts on this cat track's edge. Lit tracks pay lighting upkeep in the snow season. Off: no lights and no lighting upkeep.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_GROOMED_TIP: A groomed run counts in full and can carry snow guns and lights. Off: no upkeep, nothing drawn on the ground, natural snow only.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_NEEDS_GROOMED: Snow guns and lights need a groomed run.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_PAID: Its one-time fee is paid: turning it back on costs nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_PROPS_UNPAID: Turning it on for the first time charges a one-time fee based on the run's area.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_RIDE_TIP: Base to top at {SPEED} m/s line speed, at 1× game speed.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_CAPACITY_TIP: {SEATS} seats per chair or cabin at {SPEED} m/s. Tram: time at stops included. None without power or an open run. Riders are not simulated.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFTS_TOTAL_CAPACITY_TIP: Sum over complete lifts with power and an open run. Tram: time at station stops included. Riders are not simulated.
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[NoPower]: Quarter upkeep: no open run (a tram half)
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[Unfinish: Upkeep at a quarter while unfinished
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[SectionM: Upkeep at a quarter while a section is missing
SkiResort.Hub.LIFT_COST_REDUCED[NoOpenRu: Quarter upkeep: no open run (a tram half)
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[SkiDays]: Skiers sent out on a ski day, counted when they reach a lodge. They also count as residents or tourists.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[CarSpaces]: Street, lot and garage spaces within 600 m of this lodge. Tourist parties drive here.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[CarSpacesAll]: Street, lot and garage spaces within 600 m of each active road lodge. Tourist parties drive here.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Tourists]: People in tourist groups that arrived at this ski area's lodges or Welcome Sign.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Groups]: Tourists arrive in groups. Each group counts once.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Residents]: Residents of your city who came to a lodge for leisure.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Tickets]: Paid by each guest's household into your city's balance.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_LAST_NA: Not counted: counting starts when the city loads.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_LAST_PARTIAL: Not counted in full: the city was loaded, or time skipped ahead, during that month.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Off]: Locals who ski and Tourists who ski are both 0 in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[NoLodge]: Needs an active lodge within 800 m of runs or stations. Off-road: a Hut, Summit, or a lodge whose cat tracks reach a road lodge.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Runs]: The runs set the limit: bigger and easier runs hold more skiers at once.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Lodges]: The lodges set the limit: each lodge takes 360 skiers at once, more on a powder day.
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TO_NOTE: Detected: Tourism Overhaul. It sets tourist numbers.
SkiResort.Hub.EST_TO_TIP: Tourism Overhaul sets tourist numbers in this city, so no estimate is shown.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[Unknown]: Part of the game's trip planner is disabled (another mod, or a game error), so trip times can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[UnknownO: Ski days off: the game's leisure systems are disabled (another mod, or a game error).
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_TIP: Read at each city load: which of the game's trip systems are on, and which known mods are loaded. The mod log lists them.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_NOTE[Where]: Counted when tourists arrive at this ski area's lodge or Welcome Sign, and when residents come to a lodge for leisure.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_NOTE[SinceLoad]: Counting started when you loaded the city, partway through the month.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[Off]: Lift tickets off: price 0 in Options
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[NoEfficiency]: No lift tickets: Welcome Sign stopped
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[NothingOpen]: No lift tickets: no run is open
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TICKETS_TIP: Booked this month so far: the ticket price each paying guest paid on arrival.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[BusBooked]: Coach bill booked this month so far: 1,500 a month per depot plus 300 per straight-line km to the nearest hill lodge.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[RunsBooked]: Run upkeep booked this month so far. Today's rate per month, by kind:
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[OffSeason]: With no run open, lodges and the ski school keep half their staff (Options).
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Net]: All income booked this month minus all costs: the rows above add up to it. Buildings and wages: today's rate over the month so far.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Panel]: This month so far. Income, lift costs and run costs: as booked. Buildings and wages: today's rate × the share of the month gone.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Rwh]: Detected: Realistic Workplaces. The real bill can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Rwh]: Realistic Workplaces And Households changes staff costs. The real bill can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_NOTE[Est]: ≈ Some income or costs are not counted yet. They show as 0 in the net.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Where]: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Ski area balance. One price for every ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Who]: Only ski days react to it. Other visitors and the attraction score ignore it.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Lessons]: Booked this month so far, one lesson per guest. Share and price: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassesPre]: The one sale before the season opens. It is part of the season's sales and counts in the net of the month of the sale.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[CityIncome]: Estimate: the game's tourist income, times this ski area's share of the city's tourist draw. It goes to the city, outside this net.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Lessons]: Guests who took a lesson, one each.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Passes]: Sold once a season. Holders ski free all season and come more often. Share and price: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassHolders]: Guests who came in on a season pass: no lift ticket money now.
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[PassHolders]: Residents who came in on a season pass. They paid once for the season and pay nothing at the gate. Tourists never hold one.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LodgeSpend]: Booked this month so far: what paying ski guests spend at the lodges. Per guest: Options > Modular Ski Resort > Ski area balance.
SkiResort.Hub.UNLINKED_MONEY: Runs and lifts that are not linked earn nothing. Their upkeep is still charged.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Depot]: Ski days start here, in town.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_DEPOT: Coach bill: 1,500 a month plus 300 per straight-line km to the nearest hill lodge. It adds no skier room and no score.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_SCHOOL: +12 on the Ski school row of the score while a <icon:green> run is <icon:openpatchy>. Residents go skiing 20 % more often.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_ROAD_OPTIONAL: Off-road, a cat track within 25 m that reaches a road lodge or Ski Bus Depot brings the utilities. No guests arrive there by road.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_PATROL: Within 1 km, <icon:black> and <icon:dblack> runs score 15 % more. Runs there without a lift still score at least 70 %.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_LUXURY: Luxury lodge. Ski days stay full at a lift ticket price up to 40 higher.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_MONTH_STATION: The whole lift is priced by its length: both stations and the line. This station is one part.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_RESHAPE: Reshaping a run later costs nothing more.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_TIP_STEPS_ONCE: Each feature charges a one-time fee per run the first time it is turned on.
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_TEMP: Day average at the top of the highest run: {TEMP}
SkiResort.Hub.STATUS_TIP_POWDER: Fresh snow at the top: powder {PCT}. More skiers come.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[LiftTrainLimit]: {NAME}: tower {N}'s wheels cannot follow the rope
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[LiftLowSpan]: {WHERE}. Planned lines keep chairs and cabins 3 m clear, tram cabins 5 m. The lift tool replans a section you redraw.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM[SchoolsNotLinked]: Ski schools in no ski area: {N}
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[NoLift]: A run scores {PCT} until a running lift reaches its top: within 150 m of the line, at most 15 m above the top station.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_TIP[RunsUnserved]: Each scores {PCT} until a running lift reaches its top: within 150 m of the line, at most 15 m above the top station.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[Efficiency]: At full efficiency the attraction would be {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[Lodge]: With a lodge, the attraction would be {A}.
SkiResort.Hub.PROBLEM_GAIN[LodgesOn]: With them active, the attraction would be {A}.
SkiResort.Hub.SCORE_BAR_TIP: {NOW} now, {FULL} at full efficiency, out of 200.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Terrain]: Each extra point adds a little less: four times the points gives twice this value. {K} is the Attraction scale in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_ROOT: {K} × the square root of the line above = {TERRAIN}
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Vertical]: Vertical bonus: +1 % per 6 m, so 600 m doubles runs, lifts and school. From the lowest to the highest <icon:openpatchy> run: {M}.
SkiResort.Hub.RECEIPT_TIP[Open]: Closed runs add nothing and patchy runs add part of their value. With every run fully open, runs would add {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.RUN_NOT_SERVED: No lift to its top: counts {PCT}
SkiResort.Hub.GUESTS_TIP[Paid]: {MONTH}: {GUESTS} guests, {PAID} paid, {HOLDERS} on a pass, {UNPAID} could not pay, {FREE} free while tickets were off or closed.
SkiResort.Hub.TICKETS_NOTE[Open]: Each guest without a season pass pays {PRICE} on arrival. The price is set in Options.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[Known]: Detected: {NAME}. It replaces the game's trip planner, so trip times can differ.
SkiResort.Hub.TRIP_PLANNER_NOTE[KnownOff: Ski days off: {NAME} replaced the game's leisure systems.
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Split]: Close by {WALK} · by car {CAR} · far, no car {FAR}
SkiResort.Hub.SKI_DAYS_TIP[Now]: On the hill or on the way now: {NOW} of {CAP}
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[PassesMonth]: Sold this month so far, in the net now. Of it, the pre-season sale: {PRE}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LiftsRate]: Booked this month so far. At today's rate: {RATE} per month.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[SoFar]: {RATE} per month at today's staff and budget. {SHARE} of the month so far. An estimate: it moves when staff or lodges change.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Curve]: Ski days: as many at any price up to {FULL}, then fewer: {F1} as many at {P1}, {F2} at {P2}, {F3} at {P3}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_PRICE_TIP[Tolerance]: This ski area's lodges keep ski days full up to {FULL}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_ROW[Snowmaking]: Snowmaking · {HA} ha where the guns run
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_ROW[CatTracks]: Cat tracks · {HA} ha with guns on
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Lifts]: {BASE} a month + {PERKM} per km per lift, in full even without power. A quarter while unfinished or no run is open (a tram half). Full {FULL}, reduced {REDUCED}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[LiftsTypes]: Each lift: its type's base a month + a rate per km, in full even without power. A quarter while unfinished or no run is open (a tram half). Full {FULL}, reduced {REDUCED}.
SkiResort.Hub.MONEY_TIP[Buildings]: Upkeep {UPKEEP} · wages {WAGES} for {FILLED} of {JOBS} staff, at the Parks & Recreation budget.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_STEP_ADD: +{FEE} + {PERHA} per ha, +{RATE} per ha a month
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_MONTH_LIFT: {BASE} per complete lift + {PERKM} per km of line
SkiResort.Hub.TILE_TIP[History]: Guests and finances of every month this ski area has recorded.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Scope]: Whole city adds every ski area that exists now. A deleted one takes its history with it. No attraction line: each area has its own.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Range12]: The last 12 months. The month in progress is the last bar.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[RangeSeasons]: This ski season in color, starting 5 months before winter. Last season's same months in gray behind it.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[RangeBySeason]: One bar per ski season, starting 5 months before winter: the average month, so a season with missing months compares fairly.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Attraction]: The attraction score and the snow when each month closed. A season shows its averages.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Empty]: No month recorded yet. The first one closes at the end of this month.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Unlinked]: Not linked keeps no history. Whole city shows every ski area.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[Partial]: Partial: counted for part of the month only
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY[PartialSeason]: Partial: some months are missing or partial
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Yoy]: The last whole month against the same month a year earlier.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Staff]: The game's bill for buildings and wages, at the rate when the month closed.
SkiResort.Hub.HISTORY_TIP[Chart]: Faded bars are partial months. Hatched slots recorded nothing.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[SnowSeason]: At or below freezing: natural snow can fall.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[SnowGunsOnly]: Above freezing, but the snow guns are running.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[Thawing]: Above freezing and no snow gun running. Runs stay open on the snow that is left.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[WaitingForSnow]: Cold enough for snow or snow guns, but no run has enough snow yet.
SkiResort.Hub.SEASON_TIP[TooWarm]: Too warm for snow guns. Runs reopen when it cools. With Snow & season gating off in Options, every run counts as open.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Groomed]: Snow laid whenever it freezes. Scores more on easy runs.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Snowmaking]: Snow guns open it earlier and keep it open longer.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[Natural]: Natural snow only, no upkeep. Easy runs score less.
SkiResort.Hub.BUILD_SHORT[CatTrack]: Graded as you draw it. Always green, counts a quarter.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Unlinked]: Runs and lifts link to the nearest Welcome Sign within its radius.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Lodge]: Ski-day guests need a lodge within 800 m of the runs.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Lift]: Runs a lift serves count in full.
SkiResort.Hub.NEXT[Run]: Natural runs have no upkeep. The others pay upkeep per hectare.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_NO_PARTNER: No free station of the other kind within 3 km
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_FACING_AWAY: Facing away from the other station: turn it around
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.ALIGN_PARTNER_AWAY: The other station faces away from this one
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_SECTION: Removes 1 lift section. The lift stops until you redraw it.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_TOWER: Bulldozing this tower removes every section attached to it. Click the rope to remove one section.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_SECTIONS: Removes these lift sections. The lift stops until you redraw them.
SkiResort.LiftTooltip.BULLDOZE_STUB: Also removes the station's line stub
SkiResort.PowerJoin.REFUSED: A power line cannot connect to a ski lift.
SkiResort.StationFacing.REFUSED: This station faces away from the lift line, so the line would run back through the building. Turn the station around.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_FIRST_ANY: Click a lift station or a loose line end to start. Click a rope to remove its section. Right click closes the tool.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_FIRST: {TYPE} line: click a station, loose end or open ground to start. Click a rope to remove its section. Right click closes the tool.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PICK_SECOND: {TYPE} line: now click the other end. Right click goes back a step.
SkiResort.LiftTool.EDIT: Click the line to add a tower. Drag a tower to move it. Enter builds. Right click or Esc goes back a step.
SkiResort.LiftTool.DRAG: Release to place the tower here. Release away from the line to remove it. Right click cancels the move.
SkiResort.LiftTool.DRAG_OFF: Release here to remove this tower, or move back onto the line to keep it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_CLEAR: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The line is ready to build.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_LOW: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The red part hangs too close to the ground: add a tower or move one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_HIGH: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The purple part runs too high above the ground: add a tower under it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_STEEP: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The red part is too steep for this lift: move the tower beside it, or pick flatter ends.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_TRAIN: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The rope bends past what the red tower's wheels can follow: move it or the end. The lift still runs.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_SADDLE: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The rope bends over the red tower's saddle more than tram saddles are built for. The lift still runs.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_CLEARANCE: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The rope leaves the red tower steeper than its chairs or cabins clear. The lift still runs.
SkiResort.LiftTool.PLAN_PITCH: Towers: {TOWERS}, length {LENGTH} m. The rope runs through the red tower steeper than {CAP}°, too steep for this lift type. The lift still runs.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. Chairs and cabins pass {CLEAR} m above the ground at the tower. Drag to move it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_PINNED: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall, placed by you. Chairs and cabins pass {CLEAR} m above the ground at the tower.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_LOW: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. Chairs and cabins come too close to the ground next to it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_TRAIN: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. The rope bends {DEG}° here, past the {CAP}° its wheels can follow.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_SADDLE: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. The rope bends {DEG}° over its saddle, past the {CAP}° tram saddles are built for.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_CLEARANCE: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. The rope leaves it at {DEG}°, past the {LIMIT}° at which its chairs or cabins clear the tower.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOWER_PITCH: Tower {N} of {COUNT}: {HEIGHT} m tall. The rope runs through it at {DEG}°, steeper than {CAP}°: too steep for this lift type.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NOTHING_TO_BUILD: Nothing to build yet: click both ends of the line first.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_START: Click next to a station's line stub, or the loose end of a lift line.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TYPE_UNUSABLE: This lift type cannot be drawn yet.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SAME_END: That is the first end: click the other one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SAME_STATION: That is the first station: click the other one.
SkiResort.LiftTool.TOO_SHORT: These ends are too close together: a lift line needs at least {MIN} m.
SkiResort.LiftTool.STATION_UNUSABLE: This station cannot take a lift line.
SkiResort.LiftTool.STATION_HAS_LINE: This station already has its line. To change part of it, click that section's rope to remove it, then click its two loose ends.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_STUB: This station has no line stub to start from.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CLICK_ON_LINE: Click on the line itself to add a tower there.
SkiResort.LiftTool.END_GONE: One end of the line is gone. Click both ends again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SUNK: The station sits low in the slope, so the chairs leave it below the ground. Flatter ground or raising it with Move It helps.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SUNK_END: A station on this open end would stand on the lower ground ahead, so its chairs would leave below the ground. Flatter ground helps.
SkiResort.LiftTool.BACKWARD: A station on this line faces away from it, so the line runs back through the building. Turn that station around.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSSES: This line crosses a lift of the same type. Building it joins the two at the crossing, and the other lift gets a tower there.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSSES_OVER: This line passes over another lift. Its towers beside the crossing are tall enough for the clearance the game requires.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSSES_UNDER: This line passes under another lift, which runs high enough here for the clearance the game requires.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_CLEARANCE: This line cannot pass over or under the other lift here: the game needs {M} m between the two, and no tower arrangement gives it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_STATION: This line crosses another lift too close to a station, where the rope height is fixed, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_TOWER: This line crosses another lift right beside one of its towers, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_SHALLOW: This line meets another lift at too flat an angle, under 20°, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_OWN_TOWER: A tower of this line stands under another lift's rope, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.CROSS_SAME_TYPE: This line crosses a lift of its own type. The game cannot keep the two apart there, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.ALONG: This line runs along another lift. The game would merge the two lines, so it cannot be built here.
SkiResort.LiftTool.BEND: The rope turns {DEG}° where this line joins the built one. Real lift lines turn 5° or less at a tower.
SkiResort.LiftTool.OPEN_END: This end is open ground: place a station here to finish the lift.
SkiResort.LiftTool.ADD_TOO_CLOSE_END: A tower cannot stand that close to the end of the line. Keep {M} m clear of it.
SkiResort.LiftTool.ADD_TOO_CLOSE_TOWER: A tower cannot stand that close to a tower you placed. Keep {M} m between them.
SkiResort.LiftTool.NO_TOWER: There is no tower there to remove.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SECTION: {TYPE} section, {LENGTH} m: click to remove it. The rest of the line stays.
SkiResort.LiftTool.SECTION_REFUSED: The game cannot remove this section right now.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[SteepSlope]: The game cannot build this line: part of it is too steep. Move the tower next to the red part.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[OverlapExisti: The game cannot build this line: a tower stands on something. Drag it clear and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[LongDistance]: The game cannot build this line: a span is too long. Add a tower and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[ShortDistance: The game cannot build this line: two towers stand too close together. Move one and build again.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[InWater]: The game cannot build this line: a tower stands in water. Move it to dry ground.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[ExceedsCityLi: The game cannot build this line: part of it is outside the city's land.
SkiResort.LiftTool.REFUSED[Other]: The game cannot build this line here. Move the towers away from whatever blocks them and build again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_EMPTY: Click where the cat track starts. Right click closes the tool. To remove a track, use Delete cat tracks in the hub.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_ONE: Click the next point of the track. Right click goes back a step.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_PATH: Click to add a point. Drag a point to move it. Enter builds the track. Right click or Esc goes back a step.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DRAG: Release to put the point here. Right click cancels the move.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_NONE: Delete mode: point at a cat track. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_HOVER: Click the cat track to select it. Click it again to delete it. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PROMPT_DEL_ARMED: Click again to delete this cat track. The ground stays graded and the fee is not refunded. Right click leaves delete mode.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN: Cat track: {LENGTH} m. Steepest part: {MAX} %, limit {LIMIT} %. Digs {CUT} m³ and fills {FILL} m³.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_LENGTH: Cat track: {LENGTH} m. Steepest part: {MAX} %, limit {LIMIT} %.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_STEEP: Too steep: the steepest part is {MAX} %, the limit is {LIMIT} %. Add about {SHORT} m of switchbacks.
SkiResort.CatTrack.PLAN_BANK: In places the hillside is steeper than the track's cut and fill slopes, so some banks stay steep.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_TOO_LARGE: This track covers too much ground to grade. Use a shorter track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_RUN_SHAPE: The track's edges touch. Spread the switchback legs apart or make the track narrower.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_CROSSING_STEEP: The track crosses a run where the ground is too steep for it. Cross somewhere more level.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_CROSSED_RUN_BAN: This crossing would change how hard the crossed run is rated. Cross it somewhere else.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_LOT: The track would be graded under a building or station. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_LIFT_LINE: The track would be graded under a lift line. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_WATER: The track would be graded into water. Move it clear.
SkiResort.CatTrack.GUARD_OFF_MAP: The track leaves the map. Keep it inside the map.
SkiResort.CatTrack.NEED_TWO: Click at least two points first.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_WAIT: Wait until the cat track is built.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_ON: Delete mode is on. Click a cat track twice to delete it.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_NO_BUILD: Leave delete mode first. Right click leaves it.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_ARM: Click again to delete this cat track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.DEL_DONE: Cat track deleted. The ground stays graded.
SkiResort.CatTrack.NO_GRADING: Grading is not available on this map.
SkiResort.CatTrack.TOO_STEEP: Too steep: the track needs about {SHORT} m more length. Add a switchback.
SkiResort.CatTrack.RUN_MISSING: The cat track asset did not load. Check that the mod is installed completely.
SkiResort.CatTrack.RUN_REFUSED: The game refuses a cat track here. Move it off what blocks it and press Enter again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.TERRAIN_UNREAD: The terrain could not be read. Try again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.ALREADY_FITS: The ground already fits this track.
SkiResort.CatTrack.WRITE_FAILED: The terrain could not be changed, so nothing was graded. Try again.
SkiResort.CatTrack.UNDO_NONE: There is no grade to undo.
SkiResort.CatTrack.UNDO_GONE: That grade can no longer be undone.
SkiResort.SignDelete.CONFIRM_ONE: Bulldozing this Welcome Sign also deletes the 1 ski run linked to it, with its glade trees and border props. There is no refund and no undo. Lifts and buildings stay. To move the sign, use Relocate in its info panel. To remove everything this mod placed in the city, use Delete all ski resort content in Options > Modular Ski Resort > Reset. Bulldoze it?
SkiResort.SignDelete.CONFIRM_MANY: Bulldozing this Welcome Sign also deletes the {COUNT} ski runs linked to it, with their glade trees and border props. There is no refund and no undo. Lifts and buildings stay. To move the sign, use Relocate in its info panel. To remove everything this mod placed in the city, use Delete all ski resort content in Options > Modular Ski Resort > Reset. Bulldoze it?
